title: Introduction
content: Sky Mate Digital ("Sky Mate," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect through our website, skymatedigital.com, and in the course of providing our Shopify store creation, branding, advertising, organic growth, and store management services, how we use it, and the rights you have over it.
By using the Site or engaging our Services, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

title: Information We Collect

cols.label: You Provide Directly
items: Contact details: name, email, phone/WhatsApp, company
Business details for a store audit or engagement
Billing information (cards handled by our payment providers)
Messages you send us by email, WhatsApp, or social media

cols.label: Collected Automatically
items: IP address
Browser and device type
Pages viewed and referral source
Time spent on the Site

note: When you engage our Services, you may grant us access to your Shopify store and advertising accounts — see "Client Customer Data" below for how we handle that access.

title: How We Use Your Information
items: Respond to inquiries and deliver free audits or samples you request
Provide, manage, and improve our Services under an engagement
Prepare proposals, invoices, and manage payments
Communicate with you about your projects, including via email and WhatsApp
Send marketing about our services and offers, where permitted
Analyze and improve our Site and marketing performance
Comply with legal obligations and enforce our agreements
note: Where laws such as the EU/UK GDPR apply, our legal bases are: contract performance, our legitimate interests, your consent where required, and legal compliance.

title: How We Share Information
items: Service providers who help us operate — hosting, analytics, email, CRM, project management, design, and payment tools
Platforms you instruct us to use on your behalf, such as Shopify and advertising platforms
Subcontractors and team members working on your engagement, bound by confidentiality
Legal and safety recipients, where required by law or to protect our rights
A successor business, in the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of our business

title: Client Customer Data
content: For data about your store's customers that we access while providing the Services, you remain the data controller and we act as your processor. We process such data only on your documented instructions, keep it confidential, apply reasonable security measures, and do not use it for our own purposes.

We delete or return this data at the end of the engagement upon request, except where retention is required by law. You remain responsible for your own store's privacy policy and legal compliance toward your customers.

title: International Transfers
content: We operate internationally, and your data may be processed in countries other than your own, including the United Arab Emirates, Pakistan, and the locations of our service providers. Where required by applicable law, we take appropriate steps to protect data transferred across borders.

title: Cookies & Analytics
intro: The Site uses cookies and similar technologies to make it work, understand usage, and measure our marketing:
items: Essential cookies
Google Analytics
Meta Pixel
LinkedIn Insight Tag
note: You can control cookies through your browser settings and opt out of Google Analytics at any time. Disabling cookies may affect parts of the Site.

title: Data Retention
content: We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purposes described above: inquiry data for as long as relevant to our business relationship; client engagement and billing records for as long as required for legal, accounting, and tax purposes; and marketing data until you opt out. Client platform access is removed at the end of an engagement.

title: Security
content: We use reasonable organizational and technical safeguards to protect personal data, including access controls and least-privilege account access — collaborator or partner access rather than password sharing wherever possible. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

title: Your Rights
items: Access
Correction
Deletion
Restriction
Portability
Opt-out
note: We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. You may also have the right to complain to a data protection authority in your jurisdiction.

title: Children
content: Our Site and Services are intended for businesses and are not directed to children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

title: Changes to This Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised “Last Updated” date. Material changes will be highlighted on the Site or communicated to active clients directly.
